calculus.subject: 📐 Calculus & Algebra
calculus.question: Why does a quadratic equation with Δ = 0 produce a double root?
calculus.hint: Look at the distance between the two x-axis intercepts when the parabola vertex touches the axis: what is the value of √Δ at that moment?
calculus.followUp: Spot on! When √Δ = 0, both symmetric branches converge to the single vertex coordinate x = -b / (2a).

physics.subject: ⚡ Mechanics & Energy
physics.question: How can we find impact velocity without knowing the time of fall?
physics.hint: At maximum height h_max, all energy is stored as potential energy. At ground impact (h = 0), where has that potential energy transformed?
physics.followUp: Brilliant! Equating peak potential energy to kinetic energy cancels mass m and yields v = √(2gh).

algorithms.subject: 💻 Graph & Trees
algorithms.question: Why does a Segment Tree array require up to 4*N allocated elements?
algorithms.hint: A full binary tree with N leaves has height h = ⌈log₂N⌉. What is the maximum total node count of a binary tree of height h + 1?
algorithms.followUp: Exactly! The maximum node count is 2^(⌈log₂N⌉ + 1) - 1, which is strictly bounded by 4N.

s1.title: Isolate Boundary Conditions
s1.student: I am stuck on the pendulum problem: how do I find velocity at the equilibrium point?
s1.owl: Hold off on memorizing formulas! At the highest turning point of the swing, what is the pendulum's instantaneous velocity?

s2.title: Connect Conservation Laws
s2.student: Aha! At the highest point, velocity is 0 so kinetic energy is 0!
s2.owl: Sharp observation! Now as it swings down to the lowest point, what does the lost potential energy Δh convert into?

s3.title: Derive the Formula Yourself
s3.student: It converts entirely into kinetic energy ½mv²! Canceling m on both sides gives v = √(2g·Δh)!
s3.owl: Outstanding! You just proved the time-independent velocity equation yourself without rote memorization!

q1.q: How is the ILMS Socratic Owl different from ChatGPT or standard AI tools?
q1.a: Standard AI tools dump full answers that encourage passive copying. ILMS Socratic Owl is trained on dialectical pedagogy: it pinpoints the exact step where you are stuck and asks targeted guiding questions with visual formulas so you achieve true understanding.

q2.q: What happens when an instructor uploads a PDF syllabus or slide deck?
q2.a: Within seconds, our background AI workers extract core knowledge entities, construct an interactive classroom Knowledge Graph, and generate Bloom-tiered quiz banks automatically.

q3.q: Does the platform run smoothly on smartphones and tablets?
q3.a: Yes! Every classroom view, LaTeX math formula, competency radar, and 3D tilt interaction is hardware-accelerated and touch-optimized for 60 FPS on mobile and desktop.

q4.q: How long can I use the free plan?
q4.a: You can sign up and use our Starter (Free) plan indefinitely with 1.0 GB of Cloud Lab storage and daily Socratic AI mentorship—no credit card required.

terms.title: ILMS Terms of Service
terms.summary: Guidelines governing rights, responsibilities, and acceptable use of the ILMS AI-powered learning platform for learners, instructors, and institutions.

s1.title: Scope & Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By creating an account or accessing services on ilms.page (including Classes, Knowledge Graphs, Socratic AI Tutor, and Cloud Materials), you agree to abide by these Terms of Service.

s2.title: Accounts & Security Responsibility
s2.body: Users are responsible for safeguarding their login credentials and linked OAuth2 sessions. Please notify the ILMS team immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

s3.title: Acceptable Use of Socratic AI Tutor
s3.body: ILMS AI Tutor is built to foster critical reasoning and academic integrity. Misuse of the platform for automated abuse, vulnerability probing, or academic dishonesty is strictly prohibited.

s4.title: Learning Materials & Intellectual Property
s4.body: Instructors and learners retain ownership of the slides, notes, and documents they upload. Platform UI, source code, ILMS branding, and core algorithms belong to EduTech Innovations.

s5.title: Subscription Plans, Quotas & Billing
s5.body: Free, Plus, Pro, and Enterprise tiers carry specific cloud storage and daily AI quotas as listed on the Pricing page. Upgrades via VietQR are activated for the selected billing cycle.

s6.title: Updates & Termination
s6.body: ILMS may update these terms to reflect legal requirements or new platform capabilities. Material updates will be posted clearly on this page before taking effect.

privacy.title: ILMS Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: Our commitment to minimal data collection, encrypted transport, and strong privacy protection for your personal and academic records.

s1.title: Information We Collect
s1.body: We collect only the information needed to run classes and personalize learning: your name, email, learning role, appearance preferences, course progress, and materials you upload.

s2.title: How We Use Your Data
s2.body: Data is used to authenticate sessions, track Bloom/PLO mastery progress, ground Socratic AI Tutor responses in your lesson context, and calculate your Cloud Storage quota.

s3.title: Transport & Storage Security
s3.body: All traffic between your browser, ilms.page, and api.ilms.page is encrypted over HTTPS/TLS. Sessions rely on secure cookies and role-based access control (RBAC).

s4.title: AI Processing & Third-Party Sharing
s4.body: ILMS never sells or rents learner personal data to third parties. AI chat prompts are processed solely to deliver tutoring responses and maintain your private session history.

s5.title: Your Data Rights
s5.body: You can view or update your profile, delete uploaded files in Cloud Storage, switch UI/language preferences, or permanently delete your account anytime in Settings.

s6.title: Essential Cookies & Security Contact
s6.body: We use essential cookies for authentication and locale persistence (`NEXT_LOCALE`). For privacy inquiries or data requests, please contact support@ilms.page.
